name: Hair bow
blurb: A ribbon tied into a bow and worn in the hair, small or oversized
title: Hair Bow & Hair Ribbon: Styles, Placement & Drawing Reference
description: A hair bow reference: placements from crown to ponytail, ribbon types, what bows add to a character design, and how to draw loops, knots and folds.
answer: A hair bow is a ribbon or piece of fabric tied or sewn into a bow and worn in the hair, either clipped on, tied around a ponytail or worn on a headband. In character design a hair bow is one of the quickest ways to add sweetness, colour and a recognisable silhouette.

body: Bows have long been part of children's and young women's fashion in many cultures, and that history gives them a sweet, polite feel. A large bow also extends the head's silhouette, which is why designers use it as a signature: Reimu Hakurei's big red bow from the Touhou Project games is instantly recognisable.

The bow's material changes the message. Satin ribbon feels formal, lace feels romantic, plain cotton feels homely, and a black bow on a pale outfit reads as gothic. Bows are a staple of Lolita fashion, the Japanese street-fashion style, where they are worn as large head bows.

sections.h: How to draw a hair bow
body: Build the bow from four parts: a small central knot, two loops and two tails. Draw the knot first, then the loops as flattened cones that pinch into the knot and flare outward. The tails hang from behind the knot and end in a straight, angled or V-shaped cut.

Fabric folds tell the viewer it is tied. Add two or three compression folds radiating from the knot on each loop, and let the tails twist so you see both the front and back of the ribbon. Thicker fabric gives fewer, rounder folds; thin ribbon gives sharp, many folds.
The bow must sit on the head's surface, so curve its base with the skull and let the hair dip slightly where it is tied.

For cosplay, stiffen large bows with interfacing or a wire edge so the loops hold their shape, and attach them with clips sewn behind the knot. Match the ribbon colour to an accent in the outfit to tie the look together.
A three-quarter or back three-quarter angle shows the full bow shape; straight-on views can flatten a back bow into a thin line.

faq.q: What is the difference between a hair bow and a hair ribbon?
faq.a: A ribbon is the strip of material; a bow is the ribbon tied into loops. In practice the words are used almost interchangeably.

faq.q: Where should a hair bow go?
faq.a: Anywhere the hair is gathered or parted: on the crown, at the back of a half-up style, at the side, or over a ponytail tie.

faq.q: How do I make a big bow stand up?
faq.a: Use stiff ribbon, add interfacing or wire inside the loops, and attach it close to the knot with a strong clip.
